evals.name: create-devcontainer-publish
evals.prompt: Create a workflow to publish my devcontainer features. The repository has features in src/.
evals.expected_output: Complete publish-features.yml workflow with test discovery, test matrix job, and publish job to ghcr.io.
assertions: Workflow has discover, test, and publish jobs

evals.name: create-custom-test
evals.prompt: Create a workflow that runs tests on every pull request. Tests are run with 'npm test'.
evals.expected_output: Generic workflow with pull_request trigger and npm test step.

evals.name: custom-workflow-name
evals.prompt: Create a workflow named 'release.yml' that triggers on pushes to main and runs a build script.
evals.expected_output: Workflow at .github/workflows/release.yml with push trigger for main branch.
